nonquotient_application.scope: Literal Weisner L has no balanced Z2 quotient (it has classical transversals). Among 3,365,592 triples of disjoint transversals, 3,363,624 have a sector-context triangle forcing repeated rays; 1,968 triangle-free supports remain. Among 1,197 distinct support patterns formed by 3 colors of the ten normalized complete classical mates, 1,194 force just three H-rays and at most73 total rays. This is L-and-support-specific and does not classify arbitrary sectors. The universal 90-ray candidate, if reviewed, also covers those remaining sector patterns.
